verdict.rationale: Clara's marketing claims Clara Intelligence gives "real-time insights that centralize and analyze all company spend." Its transactions API docs list near-real-time monitoring and analysis by user, team, or category, backed by signed transaction-status webhooks. However, the team/category breakdown is framed as something developers build on the API, not as a documented founder-facing view, and there is no evidence of merchant-level breakdown. Missing for 10: documented in-product dashboard with team/category/merchant breakdowns, explicit merchant-level spend views, evidence of same-day freshness, independent or hands-on corroboration.
